newsitem.title: USA: CPT says unit sues Steel of West Va..
newsitem.headline: CPT says unit sues Steel of West Va..

text.p: CPT Holdings Inc said its unit, Mentmore Holdings, has filed a lawsuit against Steel of West Virginia asking to inspect and copy its official list of shareholders.
CPT said Steel has refused to allow Mentmore to view this list. Mentmore is a stockholder in Steel.
CPT said the lawsuit was filed in the Court of Chancery in Delaware.
CPT said it has contacted Steel several times to discuss a merger with the CPT unit J&L Structural Inc.
After Steel rejected the $9 per share offer, CPT said it was considering several actions.

These actions include buying Steel shares on the open market, initiating a tender offer for all of Steel's shares, initiating a proxy contest, and calling for a special meeting of shareholders so it can put forth its proposal.
A Steel of West Virginia spokesman said the company declined to comment.
